Active-set management with bloom-filter pruning, node lookup, and peer rotation.

# Purpose
This file implements the active set manager used to track peers in 25 stake buckets, with up to 12 peers per bucket. It defines the memory layout helpers [`fd_active_set_align`](<#fd_active_set_align>) and [`fd_active_set_footprint`](<#fd_active_set_footprint>), then provides construction and validation functions [`fd_active_set_new`](<#fd_active_set_new>) and [`fd_active_set_join`](<#fd_active_set_join>) for an `fd_active_set_t` object stored in shared memory. During initialization, it allocates and joins a bloom filter for each peer slot, stores the RNG handle, and sets the object magic value after all fields are ready.

The rest of the file provides the main active-set operations. [`fd_active_set_nodes`](<#fd_active_set_nodes>) selects peer indices for a given identity and origin pair while applying bloom-filter based prune checks and special-case rules for the origin peer. [`fd_active_set_node_pubkey`](<#fd_active_set_node_pubkey>) returns the public key for a peer index, and [`fd_active_set_prune`](<#fd_active_set_prune>) records a prune event in the bloom filter for the matching peer. [`fd_active_set_rotate`](<#fd_active_set_rotate>) updates one bucket by removing a peer from `fd_crds_t`, sampling a replacement, reinitializing the bloom filter, and storing the new peer public key.
